thesis_statement: Eaton is a leading electrical-equipment maker whose switchgear, power distribution and power-quality products are in short supply for data centers, utilities and industrial reshoring; record orders and backlog support multi-year organic growth, with aerospace as a second engine.

base.summary: Low-double-digit organic growth and roughly 12% adjusted EPS growth as the electrical backlog converts.

bull.summary: Data-center and grid spending keeps accelerating and the Mobility separation lifts the growth and margin mix.
drivers: Mobility Reverse Morris Trust close (expected Q1 2027)

bear.summary: Data-center capex pauses while a premium multiple de-rates and acquisition leverage limits flexibility.

key_risks: Premium valuation: GAAP trailing P/E ~45 and forward P/E ~27; a demand pause would hit the multiple hard.
Leverage is elevated after acquisitions (net debt ~$21.3B, ~3.7x annualized EBITDA on the aggregator's Q1 basis).
Q2 segment margin 23.1% was down 80 bp year over year despite record sales, reflecting acquisition mix.

invalidation_reasons.price: Close below the live guarded-SQL reference_invalidation_level (363.48 at the 2026-09-26 renewal). SQL governs after any later renewal; this text does not.
fundamental: Electrical twelve-month rolling orders turn negative year over year.
Full-year adjusted EPS guidance is cut, or segment margins stay below 21% for two quarters.
